detail.title: Theoretical Frameworks for Objective-Constraint Misalignment
detail.summary: This notebook explores the alignment problem within specialized domains, specifically healthcare and intelligent transportation, noting that creator-imposed constraints often interact with systemic objectives in ways that require rigorous verification.
